957.key_check: No Barnes or Paget key is held in the repository; none tested. No cipher word read.
957.duplicates: Unchanged from the vetting of 29 Oct 2026: the March item of grouped lead 903 is this draft (Green 1867 no. 75). Catalogue and leads searched again on 18 Nov 2026 for Barnes and 'J. to A.': no other record.
957.closed: Same draft as the March item of lead 903; this record keeps it. Only the date and source fields change: Green p. 328 dates the draft 14 March 1593, as the vetting of 29 Oct 2026 already said, while the top-level year and date say 1594.
957.supersedes: Same verdict as the vetting of 29 Oct 2026. New evidence: the manuscript seen (SP 12/244 f. 140r-v), so the shelfmark, folio, links and access fields are corrected, and the year is set to 1593 as that vetting found.

seen.extent: The June letter of Wicham to Derick, 1 June [1594], SP 12/283a ff. 151-152, enclosure 75.I; the September and August letters ff. 153-155; three keys ff. 156-158 (Green 1870, p. 175, enclosures 75.V-VII).
seen.cipher: Three-digit numbers and graphic signs in the June, September and August letters; five agreed numbers in the September and August letters have entries in the first key (wicham/NOTES_results.md).

903.key_check: The three keys enclosed with the letters survive at SP 12/283a ff. 156-158 and were transcribed (wicham/key/). Two pre-registered tests of the first key missed their marks: September 2 of 3 names (all three required; best of 1,000 shuffles 1), July-August 2 of 8 with one letter scoring nothing (3 needed, one per letter). No word of the June letter is read.
903.key_in_volume: SP 12/283a ff. 156-158: number tables, five shifted alphabets and a graphic alphabet (Green 1870, p. 175, enclosures 75.V-VII).
903.duplicates: The January hit is Bristowe [Moody] to White, 28 Jan 1592, Green (1867) p. 175 no. 26: catalogue 955. The March hit is Barnes to Paget, 14 Mar 1593: lead 957. The Andrada item is lead 1007. The June Wicham letter has no record of its own (leads.json and catalogue.json searched for Wicham, Derick and Sterrell, 22 Nov 2026).
903.closed: The grouped record stays closed: its January and March items are catalogue 955 and lead 957. The June item named in it does exist, in the 1601-1603 calendar (Green 1870 no. 75.I), not in the 1591-1594 volume that the vetting of 16 Nov 2026 searched; it survives with its keys and could be split off as a lead of its own.
903.supersedes: Same verdict as the vetting of 16 Nov 2026, which found no Allen letter of 28 Jan and no Wicham letter of 1 June in the 1591-1594 calendar. New evidence: the January item identified as catalogue 955, and the Wicham letter found in Green (1870) and on the manuscript with three keys, so the title, dates, shelfmark and links are corrected.
